ESSENTIAL MATHEMATICS — TERMLY EXAM #14
====

GRADE: Grade 11
SUBJECT: ESSENTIAL MATHEMATICS
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Solve for x: x + 4 = 15. (1 mark)
   A. 11
   B. 15
   C. 4
   D. 12

2. What is 8 × 7? (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 56
   C. 15
   D. 57

3. In a right-angled triangle, the two shorter sides are 5 cm and 12 cm. Find the hypotenuse. (1 mark)
   A. 15
   B. 7
   C. 17
   D. 13

4. In the number 3141, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 10
   B. 40
   C. 4
   D. 400

5. A square plot has side 9 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 18
   B. 81
   C. 36
   D. 90

6. What is 8 × 9? (1 mark)
   A. 17

   D. 73

7. What is 4 × 8? (1 mark)

12. What is 4 × 4? (1 mark)
   A. 8

13. What is the square of 5? (1 mark)
   A. 10

   C. 5

14. What is the square of 9? (1 mark)
   A. 81
   B. 9
   C. 18
   D. 82

15. In the number 3541, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 400
   B. 40
   C. 4
   D. 10

16. A square plot has side 12 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 48
   B. 24
   C. 156
   D. 144

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
